items.title: Build signed full L2 evidence envelope and verify authority receipt metadata
items.context: Use claimed JobSpec/VerificationContextPack/target data to create signed EvidenceEnvelope with run bindings, provider/model/vendor, commandDigest, transcriptHash, diffHash, coverage refs, handshake fields, runnerId/deviceId, and parse/verify receipt shape from authority response.
items.userSees: `test:authority-receipt-classification` prints `authority receipt classification smoke passed: receiptVerified=true klass=receipt-backed-l2-plus only after signed receipt verification`; same-run verifier, missing command/transcript/diff hashes, bad receipt signature, receipt subject mismatch, or transport accepted without verified receipt remain non-receipt-backed.

happy.desc: A fully bound verifier envelope classifies as receipt-backed only after AuthorityReceipt signature verification and subject binding to that exact evidence envelope pass.

edge.desc: Same-run verifier, missing commandDigest/transcriptHash/diffHash, receipt signature mismatch, or receipt subjectId/subjectDigest mismatch cannot classify as receipt-backed.

adversarial.desc: Transport accepted:true without verified receipt remains thin-client transport accepted and cannot pass production authority classification.

items.title: Add local/off versus enforce E2E tests, docs, and Lattice parallel report evidence
items.context: Run full smoke matrix: local/off lifecycle still works with no server; shadow warns but writes local; enforce missing server blocks runner only; enforce fake server success reaches receipt-backed classification. Record Lattice parallel_wave/plan/dispatch/report artifacts as non-authoritative scheduling evidence.
items.userSees: Final transcript contains local/off PASS, shadow warning PASS, enforce fake-server receipt PASS, enforce no-server runner fail-closed, and `parallel_report` stating productionDone=false for planning artifacts.

happy.desc: A single matrix smoke prints local/off PASS, shadow warning PASS, enforce fake-server receipt PASS, enforce no-server runner fail-closed PASS, and parallel_report productionDone=false.

edge.desc: A live Python authority smoke is documented and self-skips unless KOALA_AUTHORITY_LIVE_URL and KOALA_AUTHORITY_LIVE_PUBLIC_KEY are present.

adversarial.desc: Parallel Wave/dispatch/report outputs remain read-only scheduling artifacts with productionDone=false, receiptRefs empty/unverified, and cannot satisfy DONE by themselves.
